metadata.name: Classic
metadata.description: Responsive HTML theme with API navigation, topic menus, light and dark color modes, search, and configurable branding.
metadata.author: Kambiz Khojasteh

projectName.description: Project name shown in the header brand and browser page titles. On the home page it becomes the entire title; on other pages it prefixes the page title.

projectSlogan.description: Short tagline shown beneath the project name in the header brand.

projectLogoUri.description: Absolute or output-root-relative URI of the single logo shown in the header. It is used only when both color-specific logo parameters are not set.

projectLogoDarkUri.description: Absolute or output-root-relative URI of the logo displayed in dark color mode. It takes effect only when projectLogoLightUri is also set; together they replace projectLogoUri.

projectLogoLightUri.description: Absolute or output-root-relative URI of the logo displayed in light color mode. It takes effect only when projectLogoDarkUri is also set; together they replace projectLogoUri.

faviconUri.description: Absolute or output-root-relative URI added to every page as its browser favicon.

styleUri.description: Absolute or output-root-relative URI of an additional stylesheet loaded after the theme's bundled styles, allowing it to extend or override them.

scriptUri.description: Absolute or output-root-relative URI of an additional script loaded after the theme bundles and Prism syntax highlighting script.

pageHeader.description: Markdown rendered above the main content on every page. Accepts one string or an array of strings joined with newlines, and may contain Handlebars expressions that use the page's template data.

pageFooter.description: Markdown rendered in the left side of every page footer. Accepts one string or an array of strings joined with newlines, and may contain Handlebars expressions that use the page's template data.

pageFooterRight.description: Markdown rendered in the right side of every page footer. Accepts one string or an array of strings joined with newlines, and may contain Handlebars expressions that use the page's template data.

menuItems.description: Top menu entries. An object uses title for its label, optional url for its link, and optional items for a nested submenu. A string names a topic slug to insert, "*" inserts all documentation topics, and "-" inserts a divider; these forms may be used at any nesting level. An empty array hides the menu bar.

excludeBreadcrumb.description: When true, removes the breadcrumb trail below the page header.

excludeLeftSidebar.description: When true, removes the searchable site navigation from the left sidebar and its mobile navigation button.

excludeRightSidebar.description: When true, removes the right sidebar containing navigation for sections on the current page.

groupTypesByNamespace.description: When true, retains namespace groups in the left API navigation. When false, type entries are flattened and sorted by title when namespace pages are available.

showTypeMembersSummary.description: When true, adds a member summary to type pages when the selected convention generates separate pages for individual members. It has no effect when members are expanded directly on their type page.

seeAlsoSubtopics.description: When true, appends a See Also list of a topic's immediate child topics to each topic page.

externalLinksSamePage.description: When true, external links navigate in the current tab. When false, they open in a new tab with opener access disabled.

popupAssetNames.description: Case-insensitive filenames that open in an in-page preview modal when linked from generated content. Prefix a value with "*" to match a filename suffix such as an extension; other values match the complete filename. Only same-origin links are eligible.
